fields.label: Task
fields.description: What this step of the setup is called — 'Create a company', 'Set the system timezone'.

fields.label: Stage
fields.description: Which of the three stages of onboarding this step belongs to: the company's own details, the choice of modules, or the setup questions those modules call for.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Questions are answered and configure ERPNext. Work is done — bringing in opening balances, training people — and is ticked off, not answered.

fields.label: Creates / Configures
fields.description: The ERPNext record the answers to this task produce.

fields.label: Is a Settings Record
fields.description: On for Settings records that already exist and are only changed.

fields.label: Applies When
fields.description: A condition on earlier answers, in Embark's small condition language.

fields.label: What the work involves
fields.description: For a Work step: what has to be prepared or done, in the customer's words.
